curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When a simple misunderstanding sends the woodland crew scrambling, how will Pooh and his friends manage to rescue Christopher Robin?
curatedMovie.description: On a normal day in the Hundred Acre Wood, Pooh's simple search for honey takes an unexpected turn when Owl misinterprets a note, sparking a frantic mission to save Christopher Robin from a creature named "Backson."
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Light family animation set in Hundred Acre Wood, where a misunderstanding sets a group rescue in motion.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: A misread note sends Pooh, Tigger, Rabbit, Piglet, and their friends into a rescue mission for Christopher Robin.
